headword: {建築設計|けんちくせっけい}

definitions.explanation: the process of planning and designing buildings and other structures

examples.japanese: {建築設計|けんちくせっけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}んでいる→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{建築設計|けんちくせっけい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な⟦{建築家|けんちくか}→建築家：06082_kenchikuka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{手|て}がけた→手がける：12753_tegakeru⟧。
examples.english: A famous architect handled the architectural design of this building.

examples.japanese: {建築設計|けんちくせっけい}⟦{事務所|じむしょ}→事務所：01032_jimusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}いて→開く：01979_hiraku⟧⟦{独立|どくりつ}→独立：03488_dokuritsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧だ。
examples.english: My dream is to open my own architectural design firm and become independent.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{建築|けんちく}→建築：02709_kenchiku⟧ (architecture; construction) + ⟦{設計|せっけい}→設計：03300_sekkei⟧ (design; planning). Refers to the planning and design phase of building construction, encompassing floor plans, structural calculations, and aesthetic considerations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {建築設計|けんちくせっけい}⟦{事務所|じむしょ}→事務所：01032_jimusho⟧: architectural design firm
- {建築設計|けんちくせっけい}{図|ず}: architectural design drawings
- {建築設計|けんちくせっけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to carry out architectural design
- {建築設計|けんちくせっけい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{資格|しかく}→資格：02834_shikaku⟧: architectural design qualification

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{設計|せっけい}→設計：03300_sekkei⟧: design; planning — broader term applicable to any type of design
- ⟦{建築|けんちく}→建築：02709_kenchiku⟧: architecture; construction — the broader field encompassing both design and building
- {意匠設計|いしょうせっけい}: aesthetic/appearance design — focuses on the visual and functional aspects rather than structural
